safe_repairs.action: Create symlink from provider discovery dir to canonical skill.
Remove entry from marketplace.json if plugin no longer exists at referenced path.
Report invalid fields. Do not auto-fix manifests.

unsafe_repairs.action: Report both versions. User must choose canonical.

guardrails: Every destructive operation must use resolved absolute paths.
Never delete outside approved roots from known-roots.json.
Always validate target exists before creating symlinks.
On Windows, prefer directory junctions for compatibility.
